arithmetic: exact Fraction/int only; no float appears in any claim

results.claim: F is the pinned parent function, unmodified; only the 23-name registration surface is rebound
results.falsifier: a before/after co_code digest change, or a blob-sha mismatch
results.note: the co_code digest recorded at freeze is interpreter-version specific (129 objects on CPython 3.13 vs 138 on 3.8) and is NOT a cross-run identity check

results.claim: on a held-out synthetic machine species disjoint from the parent's universe, F emits points that equal the externally evaluated capability, or abstains
routes: route A: parent bitmask machinery + closed-form law
route B: frozensets of realization records + independent simulators; sha256 equality on the frozen stream
results.falsifier: a point emission differing from the external capability of any consistent realization
results.power_guard: abstention rate and per-threshold non-degeneracy reported alongside every hit count

results.claim: the same holds on 128 machines drawn from four named architecture families whose names are provably not inputs
blindness: no string in any realization record
ast reference audit with a planted-leak negative control
k is coarser than family identity (REC and CTR share k=1)
results.falsifier: any blindness check failing, or a wrong point
results.correction: SUPPLEMENT_1_BLINDNESS_CORRECTION.md withdraws an ast-literal claim made in the frozen BLINDNESS_V1.md

results.claim: on real trained systems, F is never wrong about a truthfully-registered world
routes: route B (independent re-declaration, same measured receipts)
results.falsifier: a soundness violation on a truthfully-registered world
results.status: positive; the issue row it would serve is NOT closed, see KE-3D

results.claim: solvability of the protected tasks by SGD-trained systems at the registered budget is not a function of the registered structural coordinates
counterexamples: (GRU,8,w=1) reaches 261/400 on parity where the V1 law predicts solved
(GRU,16,w=0) misses ones-mod-3 by 19/2000 where the V2 law predicts solved
(GRU,16,w=1) hits parity exactly where the V2 law predicts unsolved
(GRU,12,w=0) and (GRU,12,w=1) solve parity and ones-mod-3 exactly where the V3 law predicts unsolved
results.terminal: the row 'Test predictor on real trained systems' is LEFT OPEN; pre-registered in FREEZE_V3_ADDENDUM.md section 6 before the V3 outcomes existed
results.forbidden: a fourth law fitted to these counterexamples would be outcome tuning

results.claim: the binding failure mode was emitted per input before any outcome oracle existed, and the confusion matrix is reported stratified by the KP-2D order class
results.honest_reading: on a truthfully-registered universe the predicted and externally attributed modes coincide by an algebraic identity, so the diagonal confirms bookkeeping only; the substantive evidence is the off-diagonal mass on the real-system universes
results.falsifier: a replayed prediction stream whose sha256 differs from the frozen one

results.claim: predicted capability as a function of the swept resource coordinate was frozen before outcomes and agrees per point
results.falsifier: a replayed curve point differing from the frozen one, or a vacuous census
results.forbidden: no fitted summary and no error norm; exact per-point agreement only

results.claim: exact empirical coverage under the registered 32-pattern fault law meets the U-2B nominal lower bound on every emission
results.definition: each of the typed-uncertainty source and the four registered relations fails independently at exactly its registered rate; on failure the true world need only satisfy the surviving cuts; coverage is summed over all 32 patterns with exact rational weights
guards: abstention rate reported beside every calibration figure
point emissions gated separately with min and violation count
FeasibleSet emissions carry no coverage number (U-1a) and are excluded rather than scored 1
results.hostile: HE5 inflated fault law (beta x 20) produces violations
results.falsifier: any emission whose exact coverage falls below its own emitted coverage_lower
results.forbidden: not asymptotic calibration, not conformal validity, not a claim about real distribution shift

results.claim: the in-universe region over which soundness holds and the out-of-universe region where a wrong point is possible are separated exactly
results.definition: a world is out-of-universe iff its realization is not a member of the installed universe; only expressivity, development reachability and observation can exclude such a world
results.attribution: a wrong point on an out-of-universe world is KP-1D restated and is attributable to registration, not to F
results.falsifier: a soundness violation in the in-universe stratum

hostiles: HE8 freeze-order path typo (required-file negative control)
controls.null: NULL_MODAL emits the modal externally-measured capability always; unsound on every point-emitting input, and on the head-to-head inputs where F emits a point the null is wrong on all of them and F on none

custody.rule: no outcome oracle, scorer, calibration routine, OOD probe, real-system runner, test or CI workflow is reachable from the freeze commit; CI asserts this with a required-file negative control
